mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals a deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE > 0.5pp rise and RSAFS < 0.5% decline) occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-shock recovery phase (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% and declining), the S&P 500 exhibits positive returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in economic stabilization.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% and declining.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 500,000 units (annualized) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 500.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90% of its 2017 base (INDPRO < 90) signals a severe supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in industrial production signals a dual shock to labor and supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE > 0.5pp rise and INDPRO < 90) occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 300,000 million dollars) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 300,000.
